SETTINGS.MouseGuardMacroShorthandL: Enable a shortened macro syntax which allows referencing attributes directly, for example @str instead of @attributes.str.value. Disable this setting if you need the ability to reference the full attribute model, for example @attributes.str.label.
SETTINGS.MouseGuardInitFormulaL: Enter an initiative formula, such as d20+@dex
MOUSEGUARD.NotifyGroupAttrDuplicate: Attribute group already exists as an attribute.
MOUSEGUARD.NotifyGroupAlphanumeric: Attribute group names may not contain spaces or periods.
MOUSEGUARD.NotifyAttrDuplicate: Attribute key already exists as a group.
MOUSEGUARD.DeleteGroupContent: Do you wish to delete this group? This will delete the following group and all attributes included in it:
MOUSEGUARD.Name: Name
MOUSEGUARD.FateSub: One point lets you roll an extra die for every axe (AXEICON) rolled
MOUSEGUARD.PersonaSub: Add one die per point spent or tap Nature
MOUSEGUARD.BeliefSub: Playing a Belief earns a Fate Point
MOUSEGUARD.GoalSub: Accomplishing a goal earns a Persona Point
MOUSEGUARD.InstinctSub: Playing an Instinct earns a Fate Point
MOUSEGUARD.GearTagSub: Gear is limited to what you can carry. Possessions are kept in Lockhaven or another settlement.
MOUSEGUARD.hungthurstToolTip: Hungry and Thirsty: -1 to disposition for any conflict.
MOUSEGUARD.angrySub: -1 to disposition for any conflict that uses Will as its base.
MOUSEGUARD.angryToolTip: Angry: (Ob 2 Will) -1 to disposition for any conflict that uses Will as its base.
MOUSEGUARD.tiredToolTip: Tired: (Ob 3 Health) -1 to disposition for any conflict.
MOUSEGUARD.injuredSub: -1D to skills, Nature, Will and Health (but not recovery)
MOUSEGUARD.injuredToolTip: Injured: (Ob 4 Health) -1D to skills, Nature, Will and Health (but not recovery)
MOUSEGUARD.sickSub: -1D to skills, Nature, Will and Health (but not recovery)
MOUSEGUARD.sickToolTip: Sick: (Ob 4 Will) -1D to skills, Nature, Will and Health (but not recovery)
MOUSEGUARD.TraitBenefitsSub: Level 1: +1D once per session; Level 2: +1D twice per session, in two different tests; Level 3: +1s to any passed test, any number of times (or break a tie in your favour).
COMBAT.askGoal: Ask Conflict Captain for the Goal
COMBAT.Goal: What is the Goal of this Conflict?
COMBAT.CCSet: A Conflict Captain Has Already Been Set.
COMBAT.NeedCC: A Conflict Captain Must Be Set.
COMBAT.NeedGoal: A Goal must be defined to start a combat. Sending Goal Request to Conflict Captain.
COMBAT.CCERROR: A Conflict Captain may not switch teams.
COMBAT.DragDropTeam: Drag and drop combatants here to assign them to this team.
MOUSEGUARD.BonusDiceHint: Added to the next roll made from a skill on this sheet.
MOUSEGUARD.NoSkills: No skills on this character yet. Add them from the Skills compendium.
MOUSEGUARD.Conflict.AssignTeamFirst: Assign a team to the combatant before setting them as Conflict Captain.
MOUSEGUARD.Conflict.MovesError: An error occurred while setting your moves. Please select new moves.
MOUSEGUARD.Conflict.NeedCaptainTeam1: A Conflict Captain must be set for team 1.
MOUSEGUARD.Conflict.NeedCaptainTeam2: A Conflict Captain must be set for team 2.
MOUSEGUARD.Conflict.DispositionStartingH: Base ability rating + test successes vs Ob 0 ± condition modifiers.
MOUSEGUARD.Conflict.TeamDefeated: Team «{team}» disposition dropped to 0! The conflict has ended.
MOUSEGUARD.Conflict.NeedDisposition: Starting disposition must be set for both teams before starting the conflict.
MOUSETOUR.Title: Welcome to Mouse Guard
MOUSETOUR.Description: Welcome to Mouse Guard! This tour gives you a brief overview of the roll mechanics.
MOUSETOUR.WelcomeContent: This tour explains the basics of the Mouse Guard roll system.
MOUSETOUR.TrayContent: The roll tray shows how many dice are currently in your dice pool.
MOUSETOUR.TrayAddDice: To add a die to the pool click the +1 Dice button; to remove one click the -1 Dice button.
MOUSETOUR.TrayRollDice: Clicking Roll Dice rolls the pool. If you use the Dice So Nice module, 3D dice with custom faces are rolled.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.BeginnersLuckHint: Not learned yet: Beginner's Luck, tested with {ability} at half the dice.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.BeliefHint: Playing your Belief earns a fate point
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.BrowseSkills: Open the Skills compendium and drag skills onto the sheet
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.BrowseTraits: Open the Traits compendium and drag traits onto the sheet
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.ChecksHint: Checks: earned by using traits against yourself, spent in the Players' turn. Click +1, right-click −1.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.DispositionHint: Conflict disposition: current / starting. Click the current value +1, right-click −1.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.EmptySkills: No skills yet. Unlock the sheet and drag skills from the Skills compendium.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.EmptyTraits: No traits yet. Unlock the sheet and drag traits from the Traits compendium.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.FailHint: Failed tests toward advancement (rating − 1). Click a pip to mark it, right-click to remove one.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.FateHint: Fate points. Click +1, right-click −1. Spent after a roll: reroll axes, «Deeper understanding» (reroll one snake with a wise) or breaking a tie.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.GearHint: Gear is limited to what you can carry. Possessions are kept in Lockhaven or another settlement.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.GoalHint: Achieving your Goal earns a persona point, working toward it a fate point
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.HealthyHint: No conditions: the mouse is healthy. Click a condition to mark it or to clear it.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.IdentityHint: Rank, age, home, cloak and the other details are edited on the Biography tab.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.InstinctHint: Playing your Instinct earns a fate point
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.LearningHint: Beginner's Luck tests made toward learning this skill (as many as your Nature maximum); then the skill is learned at rank 2. Click to mark, right-click to remove.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.MenuTraitRecharge: Recharge the trait (level I: 2 checks, level II: 4)
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.Name: Name
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.NatureHint: Nature: current / maximum. Taxed Nature recovers up to the maximum; advancement counts against the maximum.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.NewSessionConfirm: Start a new session for this mouse? Trait uses (for and against) and the checks earned with traits this session will be reset.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.NewSessionHint: Start a new session: clear this session's trait uses (for and against).
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.NoRollSystem: The test system is not available.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.PassHint: Passed tests toward advancement (as many as the rating, at least 1). Click a pip to mark it, right-click to remove one.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.PersonaHint: Persona points. Click +1, right-click −1. Before a roll: +1D per point (up to 3) or tap Nature; after a roll: «Of course!» (reroll all snakes with a wise).
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.QuickTestHint: When on, a click on a skill or ability rolls at once with the default settings (like Shift+click). When off, the click opens the Test dialog.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.RollFailed: The test could not be made; see the console (F12) for details.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.RollHint: Click: test · Shift+click: quick test · Right-click: menu
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.SpecialtyHint: Patrol specialty: every member of the patrol has a different one.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.TestHint: Open the Test dialog and choose the skill or ability inside it.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.TraitAgainstHint: Used against yourself this session (−1D to your own roll earns 1 check). Click to record a use, right-click to take one back.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.TraitForHint: Beneficial uses this session. Click to use the trait, right-click to take a use back.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.TraitLevel3Hint: Level III: +1 success to every passed test, no limit per session.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.TraitLevelHint: Trait level: I — +1D once per session; II — +1D twice per session; III — +1s to every passed test.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.WiseFailHint: Fail: helped with this wise («I am wise») in a test that failed.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.WiseFiguredOutHint: «Deeper understanding»: spent a fate point to reroll one snake with this wise.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.WisePassHint: Pass: helped with this wise («I am wise») in a test that passed.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.WiseReadyHint: All four marks — wise insight: replace this wise or get an extra test of a related skill, then erase the marks.
MOUSEGUARD.Sheet.WiseRealizedHint: «Of course!»: spent a persona point to reroll all snakes with this wise.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.Order2: mouse pup, small snake, small fish
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.Order4: weasel, star-nosed mole, mink, rabbit, squirrel, flying squirrel, gopher, snake, bullfrog
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.Order5: beaver, hare, skunk, porcupine, owl, woodchuck
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.FightAny: With Fighter or Hunter the guards may kill, wound, capture or drive off this animal.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.FightNoKill: Fighter or Hunter cannot kill this animal: they can only wound, capture or drive it off.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.FightDriveOff: Fighter or Hunter can only drive this animal off: it cannot be killed, wounded or captured that way.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.WarArmy: Killing it takes a war (Militarist): an army of at least {n} armed mice.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.WarNotNeeded: No army needed: the guards can beat such an animal in an ordinary fight.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.ScienceTrap: A trap can wound or capture it (Scientist): a Resources test against Ob {ob} for the materials, then a Science vs. Nature conflict.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.ScienceNotNeeded: No special trap needed: ordinary skills can beat this animal.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.DropRefused: Wild animals have one ability, Nature: no Will, Health, Resources, Circles, skills, traits or wises.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.SpeciesHint: The species names the Nature: “Nature (wolf)”. A species from the Natural Order table fills in its level.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.NaturalOrderHint: The animal's place in the hierarchy relative to the mice (p. 243). An animal two or more levels above the mice cannot be killed with an ordinary Fighter or Hunter test.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.TestHint: Nature test. An animal always tests its Nature: in tests, versus tests, tiebreakers and every conflict action.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.QuickTestHint: When on, a click on Nature rolls at once with the default settings (like Shift+click). When off, a click opens the test window.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.NatureHint: The animal's only ability: from 2 (cricket) to 12 (moose, bear). Never taxed, never advanced.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.NoNature: This animal has no Nature ability.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.DispositionHint: An animal's starting disposition: Nature + the successes of a Nature test against Ob 0.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.AspectsHint: 3–4 habits of the species (hunting, climbing, swimming…): how the animal acts and what to expect of it.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.WeaponsHint: Claws, fangs, a shell…: +1D to an action, +1s to a successful action, or “as a spear, sword, axe”.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.OrderEditHint: Click a level to set the animal's place; click it again to clear it.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.OrderUnknown: Place in the Natural Order not set.
MOUSEGUARD.AnimalSheet.RuleConflictText: Mice: disposition Hunter + Nature; Attack and Feint with Fighter or Hunter; Defend and Maneuver with Loremouse or Nature. The animal always tests Nature; its disposition is Nature + successes (Ob 0).
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.GoalHint: What this character wants in this mission
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.InstinctHint: What this character does without thinking
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.TraitForHint: Uses of the trait to help this session. Click: use it; right click: remove a mark.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.NewSessionConfirm: Start a new session for “{name}”? The trait uses of this session are reset.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.NewSessionHint: Start a new session: reset the trait uses of this session.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.IdentityHint: Occupation, home, age and the other details are edited on the Description tab.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.KeyCharacterHint: A key character of the mission: the GM writes a Belief, a Goal and an Instinct for them. Ordinary folk of the Territories have none.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.HealthyHint: No conditions. Click a condition to mark or clear it.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.AspectsHint: What the species does by nature: acting within these, the character tests Nature within its nature.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.AspectsDefaultHint: The rulebook aspects of the species. Add or remove an aspect to keep a list of your own.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.EffectPlaceholder: Effect in a conflict, e.g. “+1D to Defend”
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.QuestsHint: Only key characters have a Belief, a Goal and an Instinct: switch on “Key character” in the sheet header.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.RatingsNote: The rulebook rates the folk of the Territories a little high on purpose, so that meeting them is a challenge for the guards. The GM may change any skill, trait or rating to suit the scene.
MOUSEGUARD.NPCSheet.WeaponsHint: Weapons and armor give bonuses in a fight (pp. 130–132). Write the effect under the name.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.AbilityCapHint: Will and Health go up to 6, Nature up to 7, Resources and Circles up to 10.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.AdvanceNeed: To raise rating {rating}: {passed} passed and {failed} failed tests.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.AgainstRule: −1D to your own test: 1 check. +2D to the opponent (versus test only): 2 checks. Break a tie in the opponent's favour (versus test only): 2 checks.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.BeginnersLuckLearne: Used only while the skill is not learned yet (rank 0).
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.HelpDropHint: Drag a skill onto this sheet to add it.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.HelpHint: Skills that can help with a test of this skill (each helper adds one die).
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.LearningHint: A skill is learned after as many Beginner's Luck tests as your Nature rating; it then starts at rank 2.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.LearningNeed: The skill is learned at rank 2 once its Beginner's Luck marks equal the Nature rating ({count}).
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.Level1Rule: +1D to a test, once per session. Recharge: 2 checks.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.Level2Rule: +1D twice per session, in two different tests. Recharge: 4 checks.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.Level3Rule: +1s to tests any number of times: break a tie in your favour or add a success after each passed test in a conflict.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.LevelHint: Trait level, 1 to 3. Traits change during the winter session.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.Name: Name
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.NatureHint: Current (taxed) Nature / maximum. Advancement marks are compared with the maximum.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.RankHint: 0 = not learned yet (Beginner's Luck). The highest skill rank is 6.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.RollHint: Open the test dialog for this skill or ability. Shift+click: roll at once.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.SessionHint: Counters for the current session; reset when a new session starts.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.SpecialtyHint: Your mouse's specialty in the patrol (every patrol member has a different one).
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.SuppliesHint: Supplies provided by another character give +1D to the test.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.ToggleHint: Click to set or clear the mark.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.UnlearnedHint: Not learned yet: tests of this skill use Beginner's Luck.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.UsedForUnlimited: Level 3: +1s with no limit per session.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.WiseEnlightened: Enlightenment! Replace the wise, or make an extra test of a related skill (Beginner's Luck for a skill being learned); then erase the marks.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.WiseHint: Mark the wise each time you use it in one of the four ways. Four marks bring enlightenment.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.EffectPlaceholder: e.g. +1D to Attack, +1s to a successful Feint
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.EffectHint: Fight bonuses of weapons and armor (pp. 130–132) or of an animal weapon, written as one line; shown on the NPC and animal sheets.
MOUSEGUARD.ItemSheet.FixedNatureHint: An NPC's or an animal's Nature is a fixed rating: it is never taxed and never advanced.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Action.DeeperHint: Spend 1 fate point and a wise related to the obstacle: reroll one snake (not a rerolled or extra die).
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Action.FateHint: Spend 1 fate point: roll one new die for every axe; new axes roll again.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Action.OfCourseHint: Spend 1 persona point and a wise related to the obstacle: reroll all snakes. Only before Fate is spent.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Action.TieTrait: Give the tie to the opponent
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Action.TieTraitHint: Use a trait against yourself: the opponent wins with a margin of 1 and you earn 2 checks. Only before Fate or a tiebreaker, never against another player's character.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Action.TieTraitHintNoChe: Use a trait against yourself: the opponent wins with a margin of 1. Only before Fate or a tiebreaker.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Action.TiebreakerHint: Open a new versus test with the tiebreaker ability.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.BeginnersLuckHint: Not learned yet: Beginner's Luck with {ability}, the pool is halved (rounded up). Learning marks: {n}.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.HelpersHint: Each helper gives one die. In a skill test, help only with a fitting skill or wise. Helpers share the consequences of failure.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.InNature: Acting within nature (escaping, climbing, foraging, hiding)
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.InNatureHint: Within nature, Nature is not taxed on a passed test. Outside nature, tapping Nature taxes it by 1 even on a pass; a failed test taxes it by the margin of failure.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.NatureInstead: Roll Nature instead of the skill
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.NoHelp: No help is possible in this test.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.NoPersona: No persona points can be spent on this test.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.PickTraitTie: Which trait do you use against yourself? (+2 checks)
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.PickWiseDeeper: Which wise is related to this obstacle? (1 fate point)
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.PickWiseOfCourse: Which wise is related to this obstacle? (1 persona point)
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.Recovery: Recovery test (no condition penalty, no help)
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.RecoveryHint: Will or Health tests to recover from a condition: Injured and Sick do not reduce the pool and nobody may help.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.Subject: Test
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.SuppliesHint: Supplies given by another character (see the skill's description).
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.TapNatureHint: Add your current Nature rating to the pool. Not for Resources or Circles.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.Title: Test
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Dialog.WiseHelpHint: "I know!": +1D for each fitting wise of another player's character.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.ActionFailed: The action failed; see the console for details.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.ActionUnavailable: This option is no longer available for this test.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.BeginnersLuckReduc: Beginner's Luck is impossible: {ability} is reduced to 0 by conditions. Roll Nature instead of the skill.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.NoGM: A GM must be connected to apply this change.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.RelayFailed: The GM could not apply the test update (details in the console). Check the card and the spent points by hand.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.NoSubject: Choose a skill or an ability to test.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.NotOwner: You do not own this character.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.Reduced: {name} is reduced to 0 by conditions and cannot be tested (no help, no persona).
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.ResourcesZero: Resources 0: the test is only possible with help.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Error.TraitSpent: {name} has already helped as often as its level allows this session.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Hint.Failed: Failed: the GM chooses a twist or success with a condition.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Hint.RecoveryFailed: Failed recovery: no twist and no new condition.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Hint.Tie: Tie: resolve it with a trait against yourself (before Fate or a tiebreaker), with Fate (if an axe is unused) or with a tiebreaker test ({ability}).
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Note.NatureZero: Nature is 0: replace a trait with Outcast, Odd or a similar one, lower the maximum by 1 and set the current rating to it.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Note.NewSession: New session for {name}: trait uses reset.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Note.NoMarkTie: Tie: no advancement mark until it is resolved.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Note.TieTrait: Tie given to the opponent with {name}: +2 checks.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Note.TieTraitNoChecks: Tie given to the opponent with {name}.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Note.TraitAgainstOpponen: {name} used against you: +2D to the opponent, +{n} checks.
{name} used against you: +2D to the opponent.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Note.WiseInsight: {name} has all four marks: wise insight!
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Setting.AutoMarkHint: Tests of player characters against an obstacle mark a pass (P) or fail (F) on the tested skill or ability by default; the Test dialog can switch it off for a single roll.
MOUSEGUARD.Test.Warning.NoDice: The pool has no dice: no successes are possible.
MOUSEGUARD.DetailsDialog.Title: Character Details
MOUSEGUARD.DetailsDialog.GenerateAllHint: Fill fields with random canon values according to rulebook
MOUSEGUARD.DetailsDialog.OnlyEmptyHint: Do not overwrite fields that are already filled
MOUSEGUARD.DetailsDialog.SeniorPlacehold: Master artisan's name and craft in Lockhaven
MOUSEGUARD.DetailsDialog.FriendPlacehold: Friend's name, craft and home town
MOUSEGUARD.DetailsDialog.EnemyPlaceholde: Enemy's name and cause of rivalry
MOUSEGUARD.DetailsDialog.ErrorUpdate: Failed to update character details. See console for details.
